options.opa: They are preferably in the peripheral retina.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Cones -> photoreceptor cells in the retina -> responsible for color vision -> 90% CHAIN: Cones -> located mainly in the fovea centralis -> high visual acuity -> 85% CHAIN: Cones -> contain photopigments like iodopsin -> respond to different wavelengths of light -> 80% CHAIN: Cones -> have three types: red, green, blue -> color discrimination -> 85% CHAIN: Cones -> synapse with bipolar cells -> transmit visual information to the brain -> 90%
analysis: Cones are photoreceptor cells in the retina responsible for color vision and visual acuity. They are concentrated in the fovea, which is the central part of the retina. Cones have membranous discs stacked in their outer segment and are responsible for high sensitivity to light and color vision.
